name: Plate

description.value:
A hundred marks pressed flat into a single hand-sized plate, edges milled so it cannot be shaved. Introduced for the simple reason that twenty-one thousand marks does not fit in a coat. Same metal, same stamp, same absence of any rate anyone else will honour.

1 Plate = 100 Marks.

_retired: Archived 2026-09-07, not deleted. Owner ruling: the Butcher deals in ONE static currency, so Plate (1 Plate = 100 Marks) is out of the shipped set. build_pack.py globs packs-source/<owner>/*.json non-recursively (tools/foundry/build_pack.py:273), so a file in this subdirectory is not built into any pack. Restore by moving it back up one level and rebuilding.
